name: identity_group_grants
description: Permissions an owner granted to a group, optionally narrowed by identity_group_grant_restrictions; every member holds them.
lifecycle: Granted, restricted and revoked by owners with recent strong authentication; removed with the group. Audited.

columns.Meaning: Registered source permission such as sales_vrmaster:read; validated against the composed catalog.
Owner (identity_persons.id) who granted it or last changed its restrictions.
Database-clock instant of the grant or of its last restriction change.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES identity_groups(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.Purpose: A permission is granted once per group.
